$comment: Microsoft Store packaging settings (docs/engineering/27-microsoft-store.md). Identity values are public, not secrets: copy them from Partner Center > your app > Product management > Product identity and commit them. Environment variables MSIX_IDENTITY_NAME, MSIX_PUBLISHER, MSIX_PUBLISHER_DISPLAY_NAME, MSIX_DISPLAY_NAME and STORE_PRIVACY_POLICY_URL override these values (CI repository variables). Values starting with REPLACE_ are placeholders and block Store builds; scripts/check-release-placeholders.mjs lists them.

identity.$comment_name: Owner supplies the name from Partner Center > the app > Product management > Product identity (Package/Identity/Name), or the CI variable MSIX_IDENTITY_NAME. Never change it after the first submission.
identity.$comment_publisher: Owner supplies the Publisher value (CN=...) from the same Product identity page, or the CI variable MSIX_PUBLISHER. Never change it after the first submission.
identity.$comment_publisherDisplayName: Owner chooses it (open decision, package file 06 section D), or sets the CI variable MSIX_PUBLISHER_DISPLAY_NAME.
identity.name: REPLACE_WITH_PACKAGE_IDENTITY_NAME

description: Local-first studio for writers, screenwriters and production teams: ideas, story, screenplay and production planning.

fileTypeAssociations.$comment: Off until the app handles file activation (opening a package file passed on the command line). Projects are folders, so they are never associated.
